0.original: Yubli wishes you to lend a hand with Wawkesa's eatery.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Use the game bird whistle at the designated location and obtain a fledgling of Ligaka thigh.

25.original: Deliver the fledgling of Ligaka thigh to Wawkesa.

48.original: Wawkesa has requested the meat of a certain monstrous bird that dwells in the upper reaches of Kozama'uka─an ingredient he's apparently familiar with from the time he lived in the area.

49.original: I fully endorse his wish to introduce more variety to the eatery, so I thought to send our most experienced warrior to procure it. What say you?

50.original: Wawkesa has made another procurement request! His Ligaka thigh special was most well received, and he needs to restock his meat supply.

51.original: Blowing on this game bird whistle near the falls of Miyakabek'zoma should bring a fledgling of Ligaka right to your location. Once you have the meat we need, please make the delivery to Wawkesa.

52.original: I made a request to Yubli for fresh ingredients, but I didn't expect they would send <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>. Well, I, uh...appreciate the help. Truly.

53.original: Oh, you've brought the meat I tasked Yubli with procuring?

54.original: Now that's a nice hunk of bird! The dishes we used to make from this back in our old, uh, “hunting grounds” were always camp favorites.

55.original: The Hanu prefer leafy greens and bugs over beast flesh, so there's not much around in the way of meaty cuisine. A few customers mentioned they'd like something to sink their teeth into, though, and that got me to thinking about a new menu.

56.original: The meat is tasty enough just grilled over charcoal... Or maybe I can try that fried bird recipe Chekochuk taught me about!

57.original: People seem to love the recipe Chekochuk taught me for frying the thigh and coating it in “tangyspices.” I can see it becoming a local specialty.

58.original: The distinctive flavor─packed with savory tenderness─is something only the fledgling of Ligaka can provide. You have my thanks, as does Yubli. You've done me a great favor here!

59.original: Any troubles procuring the meat? If all is well, I can take the whistle off your hands for now.

60.original: I'm glad to hear Wawkesa was pleased! Such ingredients are difficult to come by without someone trained in battle─which makes us very lucky to have you around.

61.original: Wawkesa's cuisine is greatly enjoyed by our visitors, so I hope you'll be willing to help out again soon!
